responsibility: Owns the verbatim instruction record and the objective record as immutable source evidence.
mutation_interface: IntentAuthority.record_instruction and IntentAuthority.record_objective, both through AuthorityStore.insert
failure_boundary: fail_closed — the verbatim column cannot be updated or deleted, and an interpretation is stored only in its own labeled column with a source link back to the verbatim row
recovery_behavior: Append-only history means an interrupted session loses at most the uncommitted statement; the verbatim hash lets any later reader confirm the preserved words are byte-identical to what was submitted
replacement_contract: A replacement must store the user's exact bytes unmodified, hash them, keep any interpretation in a separately labeled source-linked field, and never expose a mutation path to either
